learning_outcomes.text: Design a document-intelligence pipeline over S3 content
Ingest, extract and chunk documents for retrieval
Generate embeddings and index them in OpenSearch
Retrieve with vector and hybrid search for relevance
Generate grounded, cited answers with Bedrock models
Evaluate quality, cost and security of the pipeline

integrative_case: A company wants to ask questions over a large S3 archive of contracts: build an ingestion and chunking pipeline, embed and index chunks in OpenSearch, retrieve with hybrid search, generate grounded cited answers with a Bedrock model, and evaluate relevance, cost and access control before go-live.
